test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If (y+(1)/(y))=8, find the value of (y²+(1)/(y²)).
solution:
Formula used:

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

Calculation:

(y + 1/y)2 = y2 + 1/y2 + 2

⇒ 82 = y2 + 1/y2 + 2

⇒ y2 + 1/y2 = 64 - 2

= 62

∴ The correct option is 3
